Messages.Author: wedge
Messages.Body:
Must you choose either hand or ash heap for additional life? If so,
does that mean you can only choose one type ally, retainer or
vampire cards?

Corrupt Construction

Ghoul with 1 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
[vic] When the Construction enters play, you may remove from the game
any number of ally, retainer, or vampire cards from your ash heap or
hand. The Construction gains one life for each card removed in that
way. The Construction gets +1 strength for each life counter it has.
During your untap phase, the Construction burns 1 life.
[VIC] As above, and the Construction has an additional life.

Matt

wedge wrote:

No, you can take them from both.
